sheet_points: Up to 146 lumens per watt, the economical replacement for fluorescent lamps
Link 33 four-foot bars together at 120VAC, or 40 at 277VAC
Replaces linear and general purpose strips, troffers, vapor tight fixtures, low and high bays, cove lighting and stairwells
Many accessories let the LBI mount in a wide variety of applications
Your choice of Simple & Network Lighting Controls

sheet_marks.alt: cETLus Listed (Intertek): UL 1598 listed fixture and UL 1598C listed retrofit kit

sheet_flex.headline: Switch between 3 wattages & 3 CCTs
sheet_flex.note: Standard models (WC): 3500K, 4000K or 5000K. Warm models (WC2): 2700K, 3000K or 3500K.

sheet_icons.alt: Power factor above 0.9, total harmonic distortion below 20%

sheet_plug: Optional sensors link right to the bars, no wiring needed
